items.headline: Burch runs for a career-high 184 yards and 3 TDs to lead Buffalo over Bowling Green 31-24
items.description: — Messiah Burch had career highs of 184 yards rushing and three touchdowns that included a 73-yard score in the fourth quarter as Buffalo beat Bowling Green 31-24 on Saturday.

items.headline: Buffalo gets tying field goal late in regulation, goes on to defeat UMass 25-18 in OT
items.description: — Jason Wright threw two touchdown passes to Clint Walker, including the game-winner in overtime, and Buffalo defeated UMass 25-18 on Saturday.
